interpretation: The 294 required cases contain no servo load. They test ideal 5.0 V at the J6 board pads for BEC cases, or ideal 4.33 V at the USB contacts for configuration cases.

BEC coverage is each of three pairs of ABC ports, exactly 1 A at each selected port, 0.32 A aggregate electronics, and either 0.02 A classic DSM or 0.50 A DSM capacity loading. USB coverage is 0.30 A aggregate electronics with ABC, DSM and servos disconnected.

Forty-two adversarial allocation vertices move a fixed electronics budget among actual terminals. They are enumerated cases, not a demonstrated continuous load range or a proof of nonlinear interior extrema.

The two-feed and lost-feed servo scenarios are all separately labeled illustrations from one common ideal 7.4 V BEC. They establish neither independent-source redundancy nor a continuous-current rating.

ABC 4.8 V board-pad floor includes a conditional 4.5 V receiver requirement plus 1 A times 0.200 ohm contacts and at most 0.100 ohm measured cable. Classic DSM board-pad floor is3.1394 V with a declared contact/cable allowance. These conditional allowances do not measure an installed harness.

Converter total efficiency0.85, selected effective on-resistances, prescribed mux selection and actual-case auxiliary budgets are model assumptions, with detailed conditions retained verbatim above. No source regulation, startup, current-limit dynamics, transient ESD, AC, temperature rise or flight qualification is established.
All results here were freshly computed for clean native0 PCB84229c57 with its current331 drilled objects; the model and scientific definitions remain unchanged.

limits: U5 610 uA is a maximum at 12 V, open OUT, specified control settings; use at other inputs/load states is a modeled screen.
U7 4.4/4.5 uA are selected-input maximum rows through 105 C under their input-priority conditions.
U10 140 uA is the 6.5 V, open OUT, 20 kOhm ILIM row; actual voltage and resistor differ, so application is modeled.
U8 400 uA uses its open-output maximum row. The additional 500 uA covers the published wide-differential inactive-input leakage magnitude as a conservative selected-input demand.
The U8 leakage reserve omits detailed inactive-rail current direction and return distribution; it cannot establish backfeed behavior.
The 20 uA BEC priority reserve bounds the magnitude through 330 kOhm for declared PR1/ST voltages within 0 to 6 V, beyond the 28 kOhm divider already counted. CORE bias is not added again.
The added sensitivity is 2 mA at each of three external device input/return pairs, 6 mA total beyond explicit terms; it is an engineering comparison envelope, not a manufacturer guarantee.
not_counted_again: U6/U9 operating consumption is already within eta_total; additive converter IQ stays zero.
U11 and CORE-powered bias remain inside the aggregate 0.32/0.30 A electronics allowance.

The added sensitivity is 2 mA at each of three external device input/return pairs, 6 mA total beyond explicit terms; it is an engineering comparison envelope, not a manufacturer guarantee.
not_counted_again: U6/U9 operating consumption is already within eta_total; additive converter IQ stays zero.
U11 and CORE-powered bias remain inside the aggregate 0.32/0.30 A electronics allowance.

unique_case_assumptions: 105C remains modeled copper temperature, not ambient, ferrite body temperature, or permitted X5R body temperature.
4.33/5.0/5.25V are declared source sensitivity points from project discussion, not proof of USB compliance or pre-enumeration current behavior.
42-vertex load-polytope coverage does not by itself prove global voltage extrema for nonlinear constant-power converter equations.
All CORE-powered logic/bias/quiescent demand is included once in the aggregate electronics allowance.
Configuration only: all external ABC, DSM and servo loads are disconnected.
Converter eta_total is an engineering assumption including converter operating loss; additive IQ=0 avoids double counting and does not mean zero physical IQ.
Corrected physical supply entries: TPS2553 pin6 is IN, pin4 is EN; DPS368 pin2 CSB and pin5 SDO are not power entry/return pins.
Filtered branches each have a conditional 20mA budget, with combined IMU VDD+VDDIO <=20mA. Their demand is included once within the electronics aggregate.
Finite native sheet/barrel paths and actual load returns are required; no nominal-width shortcut.
Mux selection is prescribed; no startup, hysteresis, switching or backfeed result is implied.
New adversarial electronics-current allocation, not a recovered historical load split.

U10 IQ remains the inherited conditional140uA table screen at actual IN6/GND5. Auxiliary2mA sensitivity slices are disabled; any future legacy added_auxiliary_U10.4 label must still map its actual endpoint to IN6 and be renamed before publication.

U11 supply/enable consumption and CORE-powered bias are counted once in the aggregate electronics allowance; their individual injection/contact-current distribution is not separately resolved by this allocation model.
U8 RON row is specified at VINx>=5V, |IOUT|=200mA. Effective RON outside those tests is a sensitivity assumption.
U9 setpoint uses the conservative initial PFM low factor; line/load/ripple and input headroom remain separate guards.
USB source is prescribed at ideal common connector contacts; this does not invent cable/contact tolerances.
